title: QualityRelay 17.1 agent message
description: One role-signed message on the structured evidence-request bus (qualityrelay17/collective/messages.py). Sender identity is the signature verified by the bus, never the text.

correlation_id.description: message_id of the REQUEST this answers or follows; empty for an originating message

signature.description: hex HMAC-SHA256 over the canonical unsigned message with the sender role's key

body.description: kind-specific. REQUEST_EVIDENCE: requested_kind, reason_code, hypotheses[], existing_evidence_ids[], existing_source_roots[], max_cost, deadline_ms. EVIDENCE_RESPONSE: outcome, reason, summaries[], cost_charged. HYPOTHESIS_UPDATE: belief_before, belief_after, note, basis_event_ids[], new_source_roots[]. PROPOSE_INSPECTION: chosen, net_voi, candidates[], budget, likelihood_source. DECISION_PROPOSAL: state, reasons[], evidence_ids[], control_state, control_reasons[], decision_changed.

payload.description: admissible fields only; never raw observations
